change: Read first: docs/v3/issues/bench/README.md (owner direction, decisions, how to use the reference) and docs/v3/BENCHMARK-ACCORDEE-BLUEPRINT.md. Decided: this reverses the rule in head.tsx that every header control shows at rest on a fine pointer. (1) Header at rest: an optional kind icon and the label, nothing else. State stays visible: a sorted column shows its direction arrow, a filtered column shows one mark, and both are named for assistive tech; `aria-sort` stays. The whole header cell is one button that opens one menu: sort ascending, descending, none; filter (opens the existing FilterEditor popover anchored to the header); move left, right, to either end; reset width; hide. The same menu opens on a tap and from the keyboard. The standing funnel and caret go. The resize handle from bench-table-view stays on the edge. (2) Header icon: each kind has a default 16 px icon, a column may name its own or turn it off, and a table may turn all of them off. (3) Widths: in the grid look each kind gets a roomier default width and the table overflows sideways under its pinned leading columns instead of shrinking columns to their content. In both looks, free width on a fill page is shared among the text-like columns (title, text, entity, person, tags) up to a cap per kind, while figures and dates keep their width; what is still left goes to the trailing filler, which continues the header, row, group and footer lines and grounds to the surface edge, so no tint or hairline stops short (the P3 noted in PR 1232). (4) An inline-editable cell rests as plain cell content. Its control appears on hover (a quiet affordance, fine pointer only), on focus and while editing; Enter or F2 opens it from the keyboard, a tap on touch. No bordered control per row at rest. What the code decides: the exact widths per kind on basalt's ladder, and whether the shared free width needs a contract amendment.
reference: Accordee, measured from the frames (~/.local/state/basalt-accordee/reports/tables.md 2.1, 2.3): header row 40 px with a 16 px type icon and a 14 px label in secondary ink and no other glyph; a sorted column adds one arrow after the label ("Status" on invoices); column widths at 1600 px wide: Company 265, Location 292, Founder 220, Employees 194, Website 216, Note 280, Content 360, so six columns already overflow sideways; a click on a header opens one menu: Ascending, Descending, No sorting (checked), Filter column, Move right, Move left, Move to right end, Move to left end, Hide column (red); cells are plain text with a 16 px logo or avatar, no control drawn at rest. Shots: tables/01-customers-table-rest.png, 07-customers-header-hover.png, 08-customers-header-click.png, 09-customers-filter-column.png, 31-notes-rest.png, 38-invoices-rest.png.
